title: Add new release repositories
author: mehermvr
body:
* Name of the release team: prbonn 
(team creation request in #866)

* Release repositories to add:
  <!--
  Before release repositories are created, repositories and packages should be submitted to the official rosdistro repository https://github.com/ros/rosdistro for naming review.
  The ros/rosdistro source entry link must be included for each repository.
  Guidelines for package naming are describe in REP-144: https://www.ros.org/reps/rep-0144.html

  If there are any existing release repositories which should have their contents imported into the ros2-gbp organization, list and link to them here.
  Leave the checkbox _unchecked_. The ros2-gbp administrator will check the box when they have completed the repository import.
  -->
  * [rko_lio](https://github.com/PRBonn/rko_lio)
    * [ros/rosdistro source entry](https://github.com/ros/rosdistro/blob/3c8f20c38195ebeef8bca6ad8cc136e9fe983b23/rolling/distribution.yaml#L6225)

comments.author: mehermvr
comments.body: Question: if i want to make a release for multiple distros (jazzy, kilted and rolling in this case), do i make separate release repositories or just this one request is enough?

comments.author: mehermvr
comments.body: just in case, rosdistro source entries for: [rolling](https://github.com/ros/rosdistro/blob/3c8f20c38195ebeef8bca6ad8cc136e9fe983b23/rolling/distribution.yaml#L6225), [kilted](https://github.com/ros/rosdistro/blob/4ab73d90f9defb594d95e7d8c11a3ae6694d6538/kilted/distribution.yaml#L6295), [jazzy](https://github.com/ros/rosdistro/blob/4ab73d90f9defb594d95e7d8c11a3ae6694d6538/jazzy/distribution.yaml#L7246)

comments.author: jlblancoc
comments.body: @mehermvr Just one release repo is enough for all distros.
